## Summary by Sourcery

Support the Flex service tier for eligible OpenAI models when toggled via env var and ensure stream_options are only sent when stream is enabled

New Features:
- Enable optional Flex service tier via OPENAI_SERVICE_TIER_FLEX environment variable
- Automatically attach service_tier:'flex' to OpenAI requests for supported models

Bug Fixes:
- Include stream_options in API payload only when streaming is enabled

Enhancements:
- Add supportsFlexTier helper function and flexSupportedModels list to manage Flex eligibility

ai_judgment.response:
Yes, this is an agent issue.  
The problem involves an error related to an LLM provider (OpenAI) and the incorrect use of the `stream_options` parameter, which falls under the "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" sub-category of agent issues.
